name: open-oscar-server-confirmed-legacy-offline-8079
instr:
open-oscar-server cannot recover interrupted legacy ICQ offline delivery safely across V2, V4, and V5. Make delivery confirmation-driven while preserving packet formats and routing behavior.

Atomically reserve one ordered, durable snapshot per retrieval. Its membership stays fixed until commit, release, or expiry recovery. Commit removes exactly its messages. Release and recovery expose every unconfirmed message once without reviving committed messages. Preserve ordering, message-type restoration, timestamps, text conversion, `MessageRequest` validation, and sender-visible `MessageResult` outcomes.

Correlate V2 delete, V4 confirmation, and encrypted V5 acknowledgment with the concrete legacy session and commit only its batch. Interrupted emission remains recoverable. Replacement and removed sessions release reservations; stale acknowledgments cannot affect successors. Empty retrieval creates no reservation. Repeated commit and missing or expired ownership return deterministic, idempotent dispositions.

`OfflineBatchID` has underlying type `string`. `OfflineBatchDisposition` has underlying type `int` with `OfflineBatchActive = iota`, `OfflineBatchCommitted`, `OfflineBatchReleased`, and `OfflineBatchMissing`. `MessageResult` has fields `Delivered bool`, `StoredOffline bool`, `TargetOnline bool`, `TargetVersion uint16`, and `OfflineMessageID int64`.
